expectations.text: routes-to-youtube-mode: Claude identifies YouTube fallback mode and does NOT look for local files

expectations.text: single-confirmation-with-url: Confirmation shows the YouTube URL

twitter-hook-preview: After-completion report previews the Twitter hook
expectations.evidence: Step 5 report shows Twitter hook preview line.

notes: New skill correctly routes to YouTube mode, confirms with URL, and even provides the actual URL to use when replacing [VIDEO_LINK] — more actionable than old skill.
